stories.title: Meta says it’s changing AI suggestions after posing invasive personal questions
stories.simple_summary: Meta's AI chatbot was asking very personal questions about a woman's children, which upset many people. Meta says it will change how the AI asks questions.
stories.why_it_matters: If you use Meta's AI tools, they should be less nosy about your family and personal life going forward.

stories.title: China AI developer Z.AI launches $5 billion Hong Kong share, convertible bond sales, term sheet shows
stories.simple_summary: A Chinese AI company is raising 5 billion dollars by selling company shares in Hong Kong.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors — nothing you need to act on.

stories.title: The race to build smarter machines ran into a dangerous problem
stories.simple_summary: The headline is too vague to explain what problem this refers to.
stories.why_it_matters: Without knowing the details, it's hard to say if this affects you.

stories.title: Doomsday tech: could AI really kill us all?
stories.simple_summary: An article asks whether AI could be dangerous enough to cause serious harm to humanity.
stories.why_it_matters: This is a worry some experts have, but for your daily life and business, current AI tools are not that powerful yet.

stories.title: Readers Write: 9/11, CPR rates, artificial intelligence, immigration
stories.simple_summary: This is a section where newspaper readers write short letters about various topics including AI.
stories.why_it_matters: This doesn't affect you — it's just reader opinions.

stories.title: Jensen Huang explains why Nvidia will grow an astounding 70% next year
stories.simple_summary: The CEO of Nvidia (a company that makes computer chips for AI) says the company will grow very fast next year.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors in Nvidia — nothing you need to act on.

stories.title: Mark Wahlberg is coming to TechCrunch Disrupt 2026, and he wants to talk about your work, not his
stories.simple_summary: Actor Mark Wahlberg will speak at a tech conference about business and investing.
stories.why_it_matters: Unless you're planning to attend this conference, this doesn't affect you.

stories.title: Slack can now vibe-code interactive charts and reports inside chats
stories.simple_summary: Slack (a messaging app for work teams) is adding an AI feature that can create charts, reports, and polls for you just by describing what you need.
stories.why_it_matters: If your business uses Slack, this could save you time making reports and presenting information to your team.

stories.title: OpenAI puts Pro subscriptions on hold due to Astra demand
stories.simple_summary: OpenAI (the company that makes ChatGPT) is temporarily not letting new people sign up for their paid Pro plan because too many people want to use their new AI tool at once.
stories.why_it_matters: If you were thinking of upgrading to Pro, you'll have to wait a bit until they can handle more users.

stories.title: Anthropic details distillation campaigns from Alibaba, Moonshot AI, and DeepSeek
stories.simple_summary: Chinese AI companies have been copying technology from Anthropic (an AI company) by stealing their methods and tools.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to AI companies competing with each other — nothing you need to act on.

stories.title: Meta’s AI agent Muse is now the No. 2 app in the US
stories.simple_summary: Meta just released a new app called Muse and it's become the second most downloaded app in the US.
stories.why_it_matters: This is mostly interesting as a business story — it shows Meta is trying new products, but you only need to care if you want to try new apps.

stories.title: Schools are catching on to Big Tech’s playbook
stories.simple_summary: Big tech companies (especially AI companies) are offering free training and materials to schools so students learn how to use their AI tools.
stories.why_it_matters: If you have kids or grandkids in school, this means they're learning AI tools, which could be useful job skills — but it also means tech companies are building loyal customers young.
